source.title: Influencer / Sponsorship Comparison
source.methodNote: Commercial motorsports influence scores combine reach, racing credibility, content potential, automotive relevance, and sponsor value. Unverified follower counts and demographic percentages are not published.

profile.summary: Randy Pobst is a motorsports authority with an established media personality. More than a conventional social-media influencer, he combines decades of professional racing, automotive journalism, television and video work, and unusually credible technical endorsement value.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Experienced automotive enthusiasts and track participants
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied; the analysis emphasizes authority and purchase influence.

performanceHighlights.label: Professional record
performanceHighlights.value: More than 90 professional race wins and multiple World Challenge championships.

performanceHighlights.label: Endurance success
performanceHighlights.value: Two Rolex 24 at Daytona class victories and extensive factory-driving history.

performanceHighlights.label: Industry authority
performanceHighlights.value: SCCA Hall of Fame inductee with decades of automotive journalism, television and video work.

sponsorValue.positioning: Motorsports authority whose technical endorsement carries exceptional credibility.
sponsorValue.best_use: Product testing, technical videos, instructional content, AI coaching validation, comparative testing, event appearances, product launches and expert commentary.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Value is authority-led rather than dependent on raw social impressions.

weaknesses: Current public audience counts were not supplied

profile.summary: Eric Magnussen is emerging as one of GRIDLIFE's strongest competition personalities. His national-championship background, 2026 title fight and visually distinctive gold LS-swapped BMW M3 create a performance-first driver brand.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: GRIDLIFE, BMW and grassroots performance audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: Championship credentials
performanceHighlights.value: Entered GLTC with substantial club-racing experience and multiple national championships.

performanceHighlights.label: Watkins Glen 2026
performanceHighlights.value: Won three of four races and moved into the championship lead.

performanceHighlights.label: Visual identity
performanceHighlights.value: The gold LS-swapped BMW M3 is a strong standalone content and branding asset.

sponsorValue.positioning: Performance-first GRIDLIFE contender with a highly marketable hero car.
sponsorValue.best_use: Race-weekend storytelling, BMW and performance-parts activation, garage content, technical demonstrations and fan engagement.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Commercial value will grow further as his owned social and content distribution expands.

weaknesses: Current audience scale was not supplied
opportunities: Grow social presence alongside championship visibility

profile.summary: Christian Aranha is a rapidly rising GRIDLIFE GT contender. He entered wheel-to-wheel competition in 2025 and quickly progressed from rookie to race winner and championship challenger in a highly visible Corvette program.

audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: Rapid development
performanceHighlights.value: Entered GRIDLIFE wheel-to-wheel competition in 2025 and immediately challenged established champions.

performanceHighlights.label: GLGT contender
performanceHighlights.value: Won against Matan Rosenberg and GT4 machinery and became a leading 2026 championship contender.

performanceHighlights.label: Commercial narrative
performanceHighlights.value: A clear rookie-to-championship-contender story with continued visibility upside.

sponsorValue.positioning: Fast-rising Corvette driver whose sporting relevance is increasing quickly.
sponsorValue.best_use: Corvette and Chevrolet campaigns, emerging-star storytelling, race broadcasts, technical-product activation and data/AI partnerships.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Owned-audience measurements were not supplied; current value is led by competitive momentum.

weaknesses: Current public audience counts were not supplied

profile.summary: Matan Rosenberg is one of GRIDLIFE's most commercially interesting young drivers. Two consecutive GLTC championships, a recognizable Corvette and existing Falken and Eibach validation give him a rare combination of youth, results and sponsor credibility.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Young motorsports fans, GRIDLIFE followers and Corvette enthusiasts
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: Back-to-back champion
performanceHighlights.value: Won the 2024 and 2025 GLTC championships, becoming the youngest two-time champion in a GRIDLIFE series.

performanceHighlights.label: 2025 season
performanceHighlights.value: Recorded 12 victories, 28 podiums and 30 top-five finishes.

performanceHighlights.label: Brand validation
performanceHighlights.value: The 2025 program prominently featured Falken Tires and Eibach, with Falken-branded content around his results.

sponsorValue.positioning: Young two-time champion with existing major-brand credibility and significant upward trajectory.
sponsorValue.best_use: Long-term ambassador programs, tire and performance-parts campaigns, youth acquisition, simulation and gaming, technology and Corvette activation.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Audience measurements were not supplied; valuation should be tied to defined deliverables and championship visibility.

weaknesses: Current public audience counts were not supplied

profile.summary: Chris DeLucia is a competitive GRIDLIFE GT personality with an authentic grassroots story. His older BMW competes against newer machinery, and the program's 2026 fire, repair and comeback created a compelling resilience narrative.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: BMW, grassroots racing and fabrication audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: GLGT relevance
performanceHighlights.value: Qualified third at the 2025 finale and remained a serious contender during 2026.

performanceHighlights.label: Comeback story
performanceHighlights.value: Returned after a major GingerMan fire to record multiple top-five finishes and Watkins Glen podiums.

performanceHighlights.label: Grassroots platform
performanceHighlights.value: A competitive older BMW provides an accessible contrast to newer and more exotic machinery.

sponsorValue.positioning: Authentic grassroots BMW contender with a strong build, failure, repair and comeback story.
sponsorValue.best_use: Long-form repair content, tools and fabrication campaigns, safety-product activation, BMW performance and behind-the-scenes race storytelling.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Owned-audience measurements were not supplied; the strongest value is narrative and niche automotive credibility.

weaknesses: Current public audience counts were not supplied

profile.summary: Anthony Scafuto is a growing GRIDLIFE GT competitor associated with the No. 87 Camaro and KDM Tuners. First-party Instagram insights now show meaningful monthly discovery beyond his follower base, strengthening his position as an emerging automotive race ambassador.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: GRIDLIFE, Camaro and targeted automotive-performance audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: First-party Instagram Professional Dashboard screenshots supplied by the profile owner. The screenshots verify content performance, not total follower count.

performanceHighlights.label: GLGT debut
performanceHighlights.value: Finished third overall in his first GLGT appearance at Laguna Seca.

performanceHighlights.label: Brand recognition
performanceHighlights.value: Falken highlighted Scafuto alongside Matan Rosenberg after the Laguna Seca result.

performanceHighlights.label: 2026 Carolina
performanceHighlights.value: Charged from ninth to fifth in GLGT competition.

sponsorValue.positioning: Emerging race ambassador with strong targeted Camaro credibility and documented monthly content discovery.
sponsorValue.best_use: Camaro and Chevrolet activation, tires and performance parts, KDM Tuners storytelling, Stories/Reels campaigns and targeted track-audience acquisition.
sponsorValue.risk_note: The supplied dashboard verifies one 30-day performance window but not lifetime audience size; campaign pricing should remain tied to defined deliverables and refreshed metrics.

influencerReport.rating_note: Updated from 7.6 after first-party Instagram evidence verified 61,357 views, 12,569 viewers, 55.6% non-follower discovery, +81 net followers and 144 pieces of content during July 28-August 26, 2026.
content_strengths: Discovery beyond the existing follower base
marketing_value_for_race_team: 144 pieces of content in the measured period
Niche automotive credibility and strong platform fit

weaknesses: Total follower count was not supplied
Only one 30-day measurement window is currently documented
opportunities: Convert non-follower discovery into sustained audience growth
Package Stories and Reels as measurable sponsor inventory
threats: Short measurement windows can fluctuate and should be refreshed before pricing

profile.summary: Dewey DeWitt is an underappreciated commercial asset whose Boogeyman Subaru Impreza has become a recognizable GRIDLIFE character. Dominant results, a hero car and a technical enthusiast audience create an unusually strong grassroots platform.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Subaru, time-attack and technical grassroots audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: 2023 champion
performanceHighlights.value: Won the Street Modified championship with a perfect 104 points.

performanceHighlights.label: 2025 dominance
performanceHighlights.value: Won four times, set four records and repeated the perfect 104-point championship season.

performanceHighlights.label: 2026 streak
performanceHighlights.value: Reached seven consecutive wins and track records by mid-season.

sponsorValue.positioning: Dominant grassroots technical ambassador with a recognizable hero car.
sponsorValue.best_use: Subaru and drivetrain campaigns, technical content series, tire and suspension testing, fabrication, telemetry, tools and enthusiast lifestyle activation.
sponsorValue.risk_note: The value is concentrated in highly relevant enthusiast audiences rather than broad entertainment reach.

weaknesses: Current public audience counts were not supplied

profile.summary: Aryton Grim has exceptional long-term influencer upside. Racing RUSH SR at 15, adding GLTC at 16 and developing a sponsor-oriented public presence give him the runway to become a driver, creator and next-generation motorsports personality.

socialHandles.linkedin: Approximately 2,000 followers reported in supplied analysis

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Young drivers, Gen-Z automotive enthusiasts and racing families
audienceMetrics.reach_note: The supplied analysis reports approximately 2,000 LinkedIn followers and dedicated social/racing pages; platform URLs were not supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: Early start
performanceHighlights.value: Raced RUSH SR at 15 and demonstrated front-running pace immediately.

performanceHighlights.label: Multi-series growth
performanceHighlights.value: Added GLTC at 16 and competed in both touring-car and RUSH programs by 2026.

performanceHighlights.label: Brand runway
performanceHighlights.value: Regular sponsor-oriented motorsports posts and a developed public-facing presence create long-term ambassador potential.

sponsorValue.positioning: Next-generation driver and creator with unusually strong long-term brand-development runway.
sponsorValue.best_use: Youth and education campaigns, gaming and sim racing, technology, data and AI, long-term automotive ambassadorship and family-oriented racing content.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Current value is still developing; age-appropriate management, defined deliverables and careful long-term brand stewardship are important.

opportunities: Gaming, simulation, education and technology partnerships
threats: Requires careful age-appropriate management and sustainable growth

profile.summary: Willem Drees is an exceptionally quick front-wheel-drive time-attack driver with strong Hyundai N and KDM Tuners relevance. His results show that an attainable Elantra N can deliver highly competitive performance.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Hyundai N, FWD and track-day audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: Organic Hyundai N community recognition and the @illwillem handle were supplied; a verified follower count was not.

performanceHighlights.label: 2025 Street championship
performanceHighlights.value: Finished second in points despite missing the finale.

performanceHighlights.label: 2026 performance
performanceHighlights.value: Continued resetting front-wheel-drive records in the Hyundai Elantra N.

performanceHighlights.label: Community relevance
performanceHighlights.value: Recognized organically within the Elantra N community for his track accomplishments.

sponsorValue.positioning: Aspirational but attainable Hyundai N performance ambassador.
sponsorValue.best_use: Hyundai and KDM activation, tires, brakes, suspension, track accessories, telemetry and consumer automotive campaigns.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Current public audience scale was not supplied; the strongest value is demographic and product fit.

weaknesses: Verified public audience scale was not supplied

profile.summary: Devin Alexandria Hofmann combines engineering knowledge, hands-on performance work and competitive driving. Her experience in engineering roles and performance shops supports unusually accessible technical storytelling across multiple racing organizations.

audienceMetrics.primary_audience: Engineering, Subaru, time-attack and women-in-motorsports audiences
audienceMetrics.reach_note: No reliable current public follower count was supplied.

performanceHighlights.label: Competition scope
performanceHighlights.value: Competes in GRIDLIFE, NASA, SCCA and Global Time Attack.

performanceHighlights.label: Technical background
performanceHighlights.value: Experience in engineering roles and performance shops supports credible educational content.

performanceHighlights.label: Content proposition
performanceHighlights.value: Can explain why a car behaves as it does, what changes are made, what the data shows and whether the changes worked.

sponsorValue.positioning: Engineering-led driver and accessible technical educator.
sponsorValue.best_use: Subaru and performance-parts campaigns, tools, telemetry, STEM, automotive education and technical build-to-track content.
sponsorValue.risk_note: Current public audience measurements and exact current program details were not supplied.

weaknesses: Current public audience measurements were not supplied
